name: wraps-email
description: Query SES send history, delivery events, domains and suppressions, and send from your AWS account.
long_description: Operate a deployed Wraps email stack from your agent. Read send history and delivery events, check domain verification and suppressions, and send guarded email — all through your own AWS credentials, read locally and never transmitted to Wraps.

aws_region.title: AWS region
aws_region.description: Region your Wraps stack is deployed in. SES identities are per-region. Optional if your AWS profile already supplies one.

aws_profile.title: AWS profile
aws_profile.description: AWS profile to use. Credentials are read locally and never leave your machine.
